description: This file defines extensions and customizations for stock move and stock picking models in an Odoo module related to sales, including methods for invoice creation, cancellation, and retrieving related sale and invoice data.

classes.name: stock_move
classes.description: Extension of stock.move model with a sale_line_id field linking to sale.order.line.

classes.name: stock_picking
classes.description: Extension of stock.picking model with sale-related fields and methods for invoice handling and order management.

methods.name: get_currency_id
methods.description: Returns the currency ID from the related sale order if available.

methods.name: _get_payment_term
methods.description: Retrieves the payment term ID from the related sale order.

methods.name: _get_address_invoice
methods.description: Gets invoice address details from the sale order.

methods.name: _get_comment_invoice
methods.description: Returns invoice comments from the sale order or picking.

methods.name: _get_price_unit_invoice
methods.description: Gets unit price for invoice line from sale order line if sale_line_id matches product.

methods.name: _get_discount_invoice
methods.description: Returns discount from sale order line.

methods.name: _get_taxes_invoice
methods.description: Returns tax IDs from sale order line.

methods.name: _get_account_analytic_invoice
methods.description: Returns project ID from sale order for analytic accounting.

methods.name: _invoice_line_hook
methods.description: Marks sale order line as invoiced and links invoice line.

methods.name: action_invoice_create
methods.description: Creates invoices for stock pickings, linking sale order lines and setting invoice details.

methods.name: action_cancel
methods.description: Cancels stock pickings and triggers sale order shipment end if applicable.
